we suggest a group-based system model for coded distributed computing, develop an appropriate coded scheme for the suggested model and show that the suggested code can asymptotically attain optimal computing time.

the suggested group code can achieve optimal computing time for any large but finite n, and that the decoding complexity of the group code is much lower than the complexity of the conventional scheme.
a group-based coding scheme can be designed for a group-based system model and can achieve near-optimal computing performance with significantly reduced complexity.

the following three aspects: 1) a group-based model for distributed computing; 2) a group coding scheme that can be implemented on this model; 3) theoretical and practical analysis of the group coding scheme.
the development of a new coding scheme, group code, that achieves optimal computing time for a group-based model.
the development of a practical model for coded distributed computing and the design of an appropriate coding scheme that can asymptotically approach optimal performance.
